name: Phong Nha Cave
kicker: Boat ride into a river cave
summary: River cave by boat: row about 1,200 metres in a 2.5-hour visit for the mouth the village is built around. From the Tourism Center the boat runs down the Son River, then the crew rows you in. The entrance is 150,000 VND, and children under 1.3 metres are free. The boat is 700,000 VND for up to 12 people, or 750,000 VND when the trip also climbs to Tien Son. Paradise Cave and Son Doong stay separate bookings.
heroCaption: Tourist boats waiting at the mouth of Phong Nha Cave

notice.title: The entrance ticket is not the boat
notice.body: You pay 150,000 VND to enter. The boat is another 700,000 VND for the round trip, for up to 12 people. Without the boat you do not go in.

body: Buy the ticket at the Phong Nha–Ke Bang Tourism Center and take a boat number at the pier on the left. The boat runs down the Son River for about 30 minutes. The engine goes off, and the crew rows you about 1,200 metres into a cave 7,729 metres long. On that water you pass a Goddess of Mercy, a sandbank called Tien Sa, and a dry chamber called Bi Ky. On the way back a composite walkway goes through two dry branches of this same cave, Tien Cave and Royal Palace Cave, with a Golden Bell and a King’s Bed.

Tien Son sits about 100 metres above this cave, on the same pier, up nearly 600 steps. The cave is 980 metres long. You may walk about 400 metres from the entrance. A drop of about 10 metres leads into a further stretch that stays closed. 80,000 VND on one tariff and 150,000 VND on another. Children under 1.3 metres are free. The shared boat is 750,000 VND a trip, instead of 700,000, for up to 12 people. Ask at the counter which entrance you pay before you climb.

The river runs jade-green in the dry season and reddish in the rainy season. Ask which months those are. Give the cave a morning. The summer board runs from 07:15 to 16:30 and the winter board from 07:30 to 15:45, and you need to ask which one is up that day. Paradise Cave is the wooden walkway, on its own ticket. Son Doong takes the week. The 4,500-metre kayak uses this cave and is a different booking at 1,700,000 VND a person. Ask the counter for the night-tour price.

figures.caption: The boat inside the mouth, with the daylight behind it
figures.alt: A tour boat on the water inside the entrance of Phong Nha Cave

gettingThere: The visit starts at the Tourism Center. After you pay, the pier is on the left, and about two and a half hours includes the ride on the Son River. How long it takes to reach that counter from a bed in the village is check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the Tourism Center
legs.body: Walk to the pier on the left. The boat then runs downstream for about 30 minutes before it enters the cave.

legs.heading: From Dong Hoi
legs.body: The cave is about 50 km from Dong Hoi city. The minutes are check on arrival.

hours: Summer 07:15–16:30. Winter 07:30–15:45. Which months use which clock: Check on arrival.
closed: Open daily. No weekly closing day.
admissionNote: Entrance 150,000 VND a person. Children under 1.3 m are free for that entrance. The boat is 700,000 VND a round trip for up to 12 people, not a per-person fare. With Tien Son included, the boat is 750,000 VND a trip. 80,000 VND on one tariff for the Tien Son entrance and 150,000 VND on another for Phong Nha. Children under 1.3 m are free on both. Ask at the counter whether you pay both entrances or only one. A Vietnamese guide is 300,000 VND for one cave or 400,000 for two. An English guide is 400,000 VND for one cave or 500,000 for two. The 4,500-metre adventure is 1,700,000 VND a person and includes pickup in Phong Nha town, a light meal in the cave, the tickets, a guide, rescue staff, and a helmet, lamp, life jacket, and sandals. VAT is extra. Children aged 10 and above may join with a parent and approval. Groups run from 3 to 20. The night-tour price is Check on arrival.
